case_title: Go Pal v. State of Karnataka
neutral_facts: The accused poured kerosene on the body of his wife and set her on fire. The victim was rushed to the hospital, where a doctor informed the police. The victim later succumbed to her injuries. The police recorded the victim's dying declaration, which alleged that the accused had a history of drinking and quarreling with her, and that on the day of the incident, he demanded money back, leading to an altercation where he poured kerosene on her and set her ablaze. The forensic science laboratory report confirmed the presence of kerosene residue on the victim's clothing, supporting the version in the dying declaration.
